abstract: EDUCAUSE's 2026 Workforce Report (June 8, 2026) examines how higher-education technology and data teams are adapting to AI, financial pressures, and shifting institutional priorities. Central themes: AI strategy, rising workloads, and expanding team responsibilities are reshaping the higher-ed workforce.
keyFindings: Higher-ed IT and data teams adapting simultaneously to AI, budget pressures, and strategic change
AI strategy, rising workloads, and expanded responsibilities named as top workforce dynamics
Report frames workforce change as driven not by AI alone but by AI + financial/institutional pressures
Draws on survey and focus-group data from higher-ed technology/data professionals
methodology: Survey and focus-group data from EDUCAUSE members (higher-ed technology and data professionals).
qualifiers: EDUCAUSE membership skews toward US higher-ed institutions with mature IT organizations; findings may under-represent smaller/less-resourced institutions. Report is thematic rather than displacement-quantifying — best used as overlay context, not headcount claim.
